data_point: Runs several US legal entities under common ownership
run_when: Code found 'Holdings', 'portfolio company' or 'family of companies' wording.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company runs several US legal entities under common ownership (holding company, real estate portfolio, incubator or studio).
prompt.definition: A consolidation need appears the moment a second entity exists.
yes_when: The site names several operating companies or subsidiaries under the same owner
A holding company or studio with portfolio companies
no_when: Not applicable; use unknown when nothing suggests several entities
watch_out_for: Being 'a portfolio company of' a VC fund is NOT common ownership of several entities

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

examples.input_excerpt: Acme Holdings, LLC and its subsidiaries Acme Realty LLC and Acme Property Management LLC

output.evidence_quote: Acme Holdings, LLC and its subsidiaries Acme Realty LLC and Acme Property Management LLC
output.reason: Several entities under one holding company.
